about: Tasama's July 2025 payroll template run for one client (design/payroll-addendum.md §5, acceptance). Inputs and outputs are taken from the template's Payroll calculation, Bank File and EOS-Leave July25 sheets and the four July 2025 PDFs Tasama shared on 22 October 2026. Names, ID numbers, IBANs, banks and positions are removed; the employees are EMP-A and EMP-B. The source files are not in this repository.

files: 10 EOSB Annual leave Provision July 2025 Details.pdf
notes: The template's Master Data sheet gives EMP-A a hire date of 26 Jan 2025, but the Payroll calculation and EOS-Leave sheets use 26 Jan 2024, and the provisions only reconcile with 2024. The fixture uses 26 Jan 2024; the master-data date is an error in the template.
The template rounds the year-to-date leave entitlement to three decimals (14.583 days for EMP-B, not 14.5833); the fixture's terms do the same.
The 2024 leave carry-over (12.984 and 6.983 days) and the days taken in 2025 (5 each) are inputs from the template; the template does not show how the carry-over was derived.

The template values a day of leave at the monthly salary divided by the person's annual entitlement (30 for EMP-A, 25 for EMP-B), so the leave provision grows by one month's salary a year whatever the entitlement. The fixture's terms reproduce that method. The platform's default divides by 30; for EMP-B that gives 5,867.24 instead of 7,040.55. Which method Tasama intends is a question for its payroll team.
Both employees were first registered with GOSI before 3 July 2024 (hired in January and February 2024), so the legacy Saudi rates apply.
